Deja reposar la carne 2 minutos antes de: Let the meat rest for 2 minutes before slicing: cut it straight away and it loses its juices.
DEJA REPOSAR LA MASA 10 MINUTOS. La aven: LET THE BATTER STAND FOR 10 MINUTES. The oats absorb liquid and thicken it; without the rest the first pancake comes out with the wrong texture and the last one right.
Déjala 15 segundos más y pásala al plato: Give it 15 seconds more and move it to the plate. It should stay juicy inside, not dry.
Déjala reposar 2 minutos antes de cortar: Let it rest for 2 minutes before slicing and serve it over the rice.
Déjala reposar 3 minutos, córtala contra: Let it rest for 3 minutes, cut it against the grain and serve it with the rice.
Déjala reposar 5 minutos antes de cortar: Let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Serve with the tomato and cucumber dressed with oil and salt.
DÉJALO 10 MINUTOS hasta que espese y dej: GIVE IT 10 MINUTES until it thickens and stops being watery. This is what people skip most, and it is why they end up with soup: the egg has to sit on the sauce, not swim in it.
Déjalo reposar 2 minutos en el plato ant: Let it rest for 2 minutes on the plate before slicing, or the juices escape.
DÉJALO REPOSAR 3 MINUTOS antes de cortar: LET IT REST FOR 3 MINUTES before slicing. This is the step that changes the result most: cut straight away it releases all its juices onto the plate.
Déjalo reposar 5 minutos ANTES de cortar: Let it rest for 5 minutes BEFORE slicing: with a whole piece this is the step that changes the result most. Add the spinach, raw or fried, when you serve.
Déjalo reposar 5 minutos si puedes esper: Let it stand for 5 minutes if you can wait. Freshly mixed, raw oats are a little rough; after 5 minutes they soften.
DÉJALO TEMPLAR antes de mezclarlo con la: LET IT COOL A LITTLE before mixing it with the spinach. Put on hot over raw leaves it wilts them instantly and leaves them limp.
Descongélalo en la nevera, nunca a tempe: Defrost it in the fridge, never at room temperature.
Desde que el agua hierve a borbotones, c: From the moment the water reaches a rolling boil, count exactly 10 minutes.
Desliza la tortilla de vuelta a la sarté: Slide the tortilla back into the pan and give it 2 minutes more on the other side.
Deslízala de nuevo a la sartén con la pa: Slide it back into the pan with the uncooked side down and give it 3 minutes more.
Desmenúzalo en trozos grandes quitando l: Flake it into large pieces, removing the skin.
Devuelve el calabacín, añade la pasta ya: Return the courgette, add the cooked pasta with two tablespoons of water and toss for 1 minute.
Devuelve el calabacín, mezcla con la qui: Return the courgette, mix it with the hot quinoa.
Devuelve el pavo, mezcla todo y sirve. P: Return the turkey, mix everything together and serve. Pepper at the end.
Devuelve el pollo con el jugo que haya s: Return the chicken along with any juices it has released on the plate, mix and give it 2 minutes more.
Devuelve el pollo con su jugo y deja 3 m: Return the chicken with its juices and give it 3 minutes over a low heat so the flavours come together.
Devuelve el pollo con su jugo, remueve 1: Return the chicken with its juices, stir for 1 minute and turn it off. Leave the chicken in the pan the whole time the vegetables cook and it dries out waiting.
Devuelve las espinacas, mezcla y sirve s: Return the spinach, mix and serve on the toast.
Devuelve los champiñones, añade la pasta: Return the mushrooms, add the cooked pasta with two tablespoons of water, toss for 1 minute.
Devuelve los champiñones, mezcla con el: Return the mushrooms, mix with the hot brown rice (a splash of water, covered, 1 minute).
Dobla la otra mitad encima con la espátu: Fold the other half over with the spatula, 30 seconds more and onto the plate. Take it out while the middle still looks underdone: it goes from tender to dry in a moment.
Dobla la otra mitad encima, 30 segundos: Fold the other half over, 30 seconds more and onto the plate. Take it out while the middle still looks underdone.
Dobla los dos lados cortos hacia dentro: Fold the two short sides in and roll from the edge nearest you, pressing lightly. Cut it diagonally.
Dobla los dos lados hacia dentro PRIMERO: Fold the two sides in FIRST and only then roll it up from the bottom. Roll it without folding the sides and everything comes out of the ends.
Dobla los dos lados hacia dentro y enrol: Fold the two sides in and roll it up from the bottom, pressing lightly.
Dobla los lados hacia dentro, enrolla ap: Fold the sides in, roll it up firmly from the bottom, and set it seam side down so it does not unroll.
Dóblala por la mitad con la espátula en: Fold it in half with the spatula rather than turning the whole thing: it breaks far less. One minute more and out.
Dora el pollo a fuego alto con una cucha: Brown the chicken over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil, 5 minutes, until no pink is left.
Dora el pollo en una sartén grande o wok: Brown the chicken in a large pan or wok with a tablespoon of oil over a HIGH heat, 5 minutes, until no pink is left.
Dora el tempeh en una sartén con una cuc: Brown the tempeh in a pan with a tablespoon of oil for 5 minutes, with a splash of soy sauce at the end.
Dora el tofu en una sartén con una cucha: Brown the tofu in a pan with a tablespoon of oil over a medium-high heat, without touching it for 4 minutes until it has a crust, then 3 minutes more.
Dora las salchichas enteras en la sartén: Brown the sausages whole in the pan over a medium heat, turning them, 5-6 minutes.
Dora un par de dientes de ajo laminados: Brown a couple of sliced garlic cloves in the pan over a medium heat, unhurried: as soon as they start to turn pale gold, lift them out and set them aside. Burnt, they make the whole dish bitter.
Dórala en la sartén a fuego medio-alto c: Brown it in the pan over a medium-high heat with a tablespoon of oil, 4 minutes a side, without moving it for the first few minutes.
Dóralas en la sartén a fuego medio-alto: Brown them in the pan over a medium-high heat with a tablespoon of oil, 4 minutes, until no pink is left. Let them cool a little.
Dóralas en una sartén con una cucharada: Brown them in a pan with a tablespoon of oil over a medium-high heat for 5 minutes, until there is no pink left inside.
Dóralo en una olla ancha con dos cuchara: Brown it in a wide pot with two tablespoons of oil over a high heat, in batches so it does not crowd, until it has colour all over. About 6 minutes.
Dóralo en una olla con dos cucharadas de: Brown it in a pot with two tablespoons of oil over a high heat, in batches, 6 minutes. Heat right down, half a glass of water, lid on, 35 minutes.
Dóralo en una sartén con una cucharadita: Brown it in a pan with a teaspoon of oil for 5 minutes, with a splash of soy sauce at the end to glaze.
Dóralos a fuego alto con una cucharada d: Brown them over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil, 5 minutes, and set them aside on a plate.
Dóralos en la sartén a fuego alto con un: Brown them in the pan over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil, 5 minutes, and move them to a plate.
Dóralos en una sartén con una cucharada: Brown them in a pan with a tablespoon of oil over a high heat for 5 minutes, until no pink is left.
Brown them in a pan with a tablespoon of oil over a medium-high heat for 5 minutes, turning them so they colour on several sides. If you have soy sauce, a splash at the end to glaze.
Brown them in a pan with a tablespoon of oil over a medium-high heat, without touching them for 4 minutes until they have a crust, then 3 minutes more.
Dos tortitas hacen un desayuno; una sola: Two pancakes make a breakfast; one on its own falls short.
Echa el arroz ya cocido a la sartén y sa: Tip the cooked rice into the pan and fry it all together for a couple of minutes, stirring, so it takes on the flavour.
Echa el huevo y espera 20 segundos sin t: Pour in the egg and wait 20 seconds without touching it. When it starts to set underneath, stir slowly, drawing the set part towards the middle.
Echa el pavo picado y EXTIÉNDELO SIN TOC: Add the turkey mince and SPREAD IT OUT WITHOUT TOUCHING IT for the first minute, so it browns underneath instead of stewing grey.
Echa el pollo y saltéalo 5 minutos hasta: Add the chicken and fry it for 5 minutes until golden with no pink left. MOVE IT TO A PLATE.
Echa el requesón y unos 150 ml de agua o: Put the ricotta and about 150 ml of water or milk into the blender jug, liquid first.
Echa el tomate en dados en la misma sart: Add the diced tomato to the same pan, 6 minutes until it becomes a thick sauce. Return the turkey, toss with the pasta and a tablespoon of its cooking water, and serve.
Echa el tomate en dados en una sartén co: Add the diced tomato to a pan with a tablespoon of oil, 6 minutes over a medium heat until it becomes a thick sauce.
Echa el tomate troceado y deja 12 minuto: Add the chopped tomato and give it 12 minutes over a medium-low heat until it becomes a thick sauce.
Echa el yogur y un chorro de agua o lech: Put the yoghurt and a splash of water or milk (about 100 ml) into the blender jug, liquid first so the blades can catch.
Echa la carne y espárcela, pero no la re: Add the meat and spread it out, but do not stir it for the first minute: let it brown underneath.
Echa la carne, espárcela y no la toques: Add the meat, spread it out and do not touch it for the first minute.
Echa las claras sobre las verduras y rem: Pour the whites over the vegetables and stir slowly, from the edge to the middle.
Echa las claras y remueve despacio, llev: Pour in the whites and stir slowly, drawing the set part towards the middle.
Echa las claras y reparte el pavo y el q: Pour in the whites and scatter the turkey and the cheese over the top straight away.
Echa las espinacas en la sartén con una: Put the spinach in the pan with a drop of oil over a medium heat, nothing else, and stir until it wilts and releases its water; turn the heat up to evaporate it. Take it out.
Put the spinach in the pan with a drop of oil over a medium heat, nothing else, and stir until it wilts and releases its water; turn the heat up so it evaporates.
Echa las espinacas, bajan en 30 segundos: Add the spinach, it wilts in 30 seconds in the heat.
Echa las espinacas, remueve hasta que ba: Add the spinach, stir until it wilts and check the seasoning.
Echa las lentejas y un vaso de agua, y d: Add the lentils and a glass of water, and give them 10 minutes over a low heat to take on flavour. STIR LITTLE or they fall apart.
Echa las tiras en una sola capa y hazlas: Lay the strips in a single layer and cook them for 2 minutes a side, no more. It cooks in no time and overcooking toughens it.
Echa los dados separados, sin amontonar,: Add the cubes spaced out, not piled up, and leave them 3 minutes without touching until they release on their own. Pull at them sooner and they break, leaving the crust stuck to the pan.
Echa PRIMERO el líquido en el vaso de la: Put the liquid into the blender jug FIRST: the skyr and a good splash of water or milk, about 150 ml. With the liquids at the bottom the blades catch; with the oats and the banana at the bottom they just spin in the air.
Echa un cucharón y gira la sartén ensegu: Pour in a ladleful and swirl the pan straight away to spread the batter thin and even.
Echa una cucharadita de pimentón y, ense: Add a teaspoon of paprika and, straight after, the crumbled wholemeal bread and a glass of water: the bread thickens the sauce, that is the trick of the stew.
